title: Harvest dig-mode materials, then build the timber-and-stone lodge
goal: Run the sealed Timber and Stone Lodge task in dig mode (--dig_needed True) on a fresh judged server: the judger deliberately withholds all 'log' and 'stone' materials from the chest, so the bot must first harvest oak_log and stone_bricks from the fenced material factory the judger erects near world (-12,-60,-12), manage its inventory, and only then build the 26-block lodge with axis-correct posts. Plan the harvest-transport-build pipeline, verify material counts against the blueprint's bill of materials before building, and drive the judger's block_hit_rate to 1.0 with snapshot-verified repairs.
resources: docker image itzg/minecraft-server:2024.6.1-java17 (Minecraft 1.19.2 vanilla; compose file assets/gc-366/docker-compose.yml)
docker image node:20.15.1 (Node 20 runtime for mineflayer bots and the judger's JS bridge)
process_expectations: A bill-of-materials artifact splits the blueprint into chest-provided vs must-harvest items with exact counts before the harvest starts
An inventory verification step (harvested counts >= required counts) ran and is logged before the first lodge block was placed
Harvest failures (unreachable block, tool problem, drop lost) are logged by identity with the recovery action taken
Judger snapshots verified the build after the harvest phase, and each mismatch fix is re-verified in a later snapshot
